testimonials.name: Briana Patton
testimonials.text: The idea of an Ajo meal plan for 9–5ers is pure genius. Knowing weekday lunches are planned and sorted ahead of time eliminates so much midday anxiety.

testimonials.name: Bilal Ahmed
testimonials.text: I love the concept of never having to pause deep work at 11:30 AM to figure out what to order or track down dispatch riders. That peace of mind alone is worth it.

testimonials.name: Saman Malik
testimonials.text: Ajo for food makes monthly budgeting effortless. Selecting only the days I actually want to eat and settling upfront stops random daily spending.

testimonials.name: Omar Raza
testimonials.text: Not having to think "what should I eat today?" every single morning is a game changer for office focus. Really solid idea for Nigerian workplaces.

testimonials.name: Zainab Hussain
testimonials.text: Coordinating weekday lunches beforehand without the daily group chat back-and-forth is such a relief. We can finally protect our lunch hour.

testimonials.name: Aliza Khan
testimonials.text: Daily lunch scrambling causes unnecessary friction among desk mates. An upfront lunch system where everyone picks their days is exactly what we need.

testimonials.name: Farhan Siddiqui
testimonials.text: The concept is so practical: plan ahead, pay in advance like thrift savings, and remove the daily distraction so we can focus on work.

testimonials.name: Sana Sheikh
testimonials.text: Paying once for the exact days I want means zero lunchtime hassle and no endless bank transfer receipts while handling busy client deadlines.

testimonials.name: Hassan Ali
testimonials.text: Food Ajo is overdue for Lagos professionals. It transforms chaotic daily ordering into an orderly, stress-free routine.
